{{Quote|What's wrong?''"<br />"''Danger.|Cindel Towani and Wicket Wystri Warrick|<ref name="bfe" />}}
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], the [[Sanyassan Marauders/Legends|Sanyassan Marauders]] '''raided''' the [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]], under the lead of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Terak]] and the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Charal]]. Terak and his Marauders used to raid the native [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], searching the planet for the "power of the stars," an elusive entity that would allow them to leave Endor for good. Arriving at Bright Tree village, Terak and his goons found the [[Towani family star cruiser|stranded starcruiser of the Towani]], a family of marooned [[Human/Legends|Humans]] who sought shelter from the Ewoks. The king mistook the [[Starship/Legends|starcruiser]] for the source of the [[Crystal oscillator|"power"]], and he killed its crew to obtain it. Meanwhile, the two-meter tall Marauders were taking [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] and setting the huts on [[Fire/Legends|fire]]. At the end of the skirmish, multiple Ewoks had been deprived of their liberty, others had been killed, and three of the four [[Towani family|Towani]] had fallen under the Marauders' blows. The family's youngest member, [[Cindel Towani]], had just returned from a long walk in the woods when the raid began. Having witnessed the death of her whole family, the girl was caught by the Marauders and put in [[Wagon/Legends|wagon]] en route to [[Terak's Keep]]. With the help of the Ewok warrior [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]], Cindel Towani managed to get free of the vehicle inconspicuously.
